headline: Guangzhou Intermediate Court Accepts Evergrande Real Estate Bankruptcy Liquidation Case; Two Residential Plots in Wuhan Donghu High-tech Zone Sold for 835 Million Yuan | Domestic News (8.22)
summary: A Guangzhou intermediate court accepted the bankruptcy liquidation case of Evergrande Real Estate. Two residential plots in Wuhan's Donghu High-tech Zone were sold for 835 million yuan.
why: Evergrande is one of China's largest property developers, and its debt collapse has been a central test of the country's real estate sector. Court-led liquidation affects creditors and the wider property market.
